metadata.title: About the Internet Society - Internet Society
metadata.summary: A global community of members, special interest groups, and 120+ chapters working to close the digital divide and rebuild trust in the Internet.

The Internet Is
for Everyone.
This vision drives everything we do.
Internet Is for Everyone.
This vision drives everything we do.
We are a global, community-driven nonprofit.
Together with our
Foundation
, we provide technical and policy expertise, infrastructure, funds, and skills training–key components of an accessible, reliable, and safe Internet.
Rooted in the origins of the Internet, we’re passionate about preserving the foundations on which it was built and developing its full potential.
Read about our history
.
Our Work
Our Work
The Internet is a transformative force. But not everyone benefits from it equally. 2.2 billion people still lack connectivity.
And, increasingly, our online safety is threatened by the inability to trust that our personal information is in our control.
The stakes have never been higher.
Learn About Our Work
A Global Society
A Global Society
Our community is made up of people and organizations from around the world. Guided by
our shared mission
, together, we are shaping the future of the Internet.
Members
Supporters who share our vision for an open and trusted Internet.
Chapters and SIGs
Connectors who bring members together to make change at the local and global level.
Organization Members
Doers who partner with us to achieve greater impact.
Staff
Advocates who apply their talent, knowledge, and experience for an Internet for everyone.
Board of Trustees
Champions who value our mission above all else, steering us in the right direction.
Internet Ecosystem
Organizations such as PIR, IETF, and the Internet Society Foundation, which make our impact possible.
We can all help build an Internet for everyone.
We can all help build an Internet for everyone.
Anyone can help protect, defend, and grow the Internet. Explore opportunities to help us advance our vision and make positive change.
